notes: Mobility-only times exclude path search, collision, terrain, observation and rendering.

Actual-map baseline/current use the same map, placements, direct goals, 100 warmup and 21×100 measured fixed ticks. Same-team units create no enemy LOS rays; rendering is measured separately in Chromium.
Trajectories intentionally differ because WIP13 applies finite drivetrain and arrival behavior; full-tick differences must not be attributed entirely to the drivetrain.
These are CPU measurements in this environment, not mobile-device FPS.
